source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: When the battle begins neither player controls any objective. To control one, a player needs models with an OC of at least 1 in range of it; for a terrain objective, standing inside its terrain area counts as being in range. As each phase and each turn ends, add up the OC values of all of a player’s models in range of an objective to get the level of control that player has there. Whoever has the higher level controls it; equal levels leave it uncontrolled unless it is secured (14.03). A unit belonging to a player who controls an objective counts as controlling it while the unit is in range and has a model whose OC is at least 1. Working out objective control comes first at every phase end and turn end, ahead of any other rules or abilities triggered then.
